summary: Recorded the batch-ordering detail that both the durability and read accounts touch, after re-reading engine.processSteps and the node message helpers. The engine takes one update per active node, applies snapshot updates, then sends the free-order messages (Replicate and Ping) and calls processReadyToRead, processDroppedEntries and processDroppedIndexes before calling logdb.SaveRaftState for the whole batch; the remaining messages, including vote responses and read-index replies, are released by processRaftUpdate after the save. So ReadIndex readiness signals reach the node layer before the batch is persisted while election-relevant responses do not, and the index a readiness signal carries refers to already-committed state. Added one new source range, reused the existing processSteps excerpt, and recorded a behavior entry; validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with a source create and a knowledge create. No execution was run.
